name: A document is shown to the wrong person in some state
detail: covered by the request grid (every state, person class and channel)

name: Old access survives a change of state
detail: persons who lost access at a transition, and named older versions asked after it

name: A refusal reveals that the document exists
detail: HTTP layer: same status and body True, same tool result True

name: Access crosses the unit boundary
detail: scripted tool calls by a person of another unit of the same organization, of another organization, and a signed-in outsider

name: An action is accepted from someone who may not take it
detail: the action grid, with `create` by someone not allowed

name: Legitimate users are refused
detail: wrongful denial over the grid, and the fill of the restricted search

name: A hidden document changes what a person sees
detail: ranking and scores for each person, with every unreadable document in the corpus and with none

name: A hidden document in the same unit or another unit changes a ranking
detail: search layer of a two-unit repository (PostgreSQL); hidden documents stuffed with the query words and the query vector in U1 and U2

name: A restart changes an answer
detail: the world is dropped and loaded again from the repository alone; the read answers are compared

name: A person changes position or unit after documents were handled
detail: out of scope: each fixture person has one unit and fixed positions; the engine reads them at request time, which the grid does not vary over time

name: Concurrent actions
detail: out of scope: the PostgreSQL repository uses one connection with a lock; ordering is not tested here
